CommandOptions.description: The settings of an edit request.

as_planned.description: With `data_date`, record the progress planned before it first.

data_date.description: Move the data date too, as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`.

ConstraintKind.description: The kinds of constraint, as XER files name them.

Edit.description: One change to a schedule. As JSON, `op` names the edit.

oneOf.description:
Change an activity's duration. On work not started, remaining follows
original unless given. On work in progress, each changes only if given.
Set a constraint, primary unless `secondary` is set.

date.description: The date, as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`. As late as possible takes none.

oneOf.description: Remove a constraint, primary unless `secondary` is set.
Move an activity to another calendar.
Rename an activity.

Change an activity's type. Only work not started can change, and level
of effort and WBS summary activities can't change here. A milestone's
durations become zero, so turning one into a task needs a duration.

duration.description: The duration, when a milestone becomes a task.

oneOf.description: Set or clear an expected finish.

date.description: The date, as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`. None clears it.

oneOf.description:
Record progress: an actual start starts work, and an actual finish
finishes it. Actuals can't be after the data date.

percent.description:
Physical percent complete, 0 to 100. On started, unfinished work
measured by duration percent, given without `remaining`, it sets
remaining duration too (TF-023).

oneOf.description: Take away recorded progress, so work is not started again.

Suspend an activity in progress: work stopped on the suspend date and
its remaining work restarts on the resume date (TF-020).

resume.description: When remaining work restarts, as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`; after the suspend date.

suspend.description: When work stopped, as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`; on or after the actual start.

oneOf.description: Take away an activity's suspend and resume dates.
Add a WBS node under another.

parent.description: The parent node's code or ID.

oneOf.description: Rename a WBS node. Give a new code, a new name or both.
Move a WBS node under another.

parent.description: The new parent's code or ID.

oneOf.description: Move an activity to another WBS node.
Add a resource to the file's resource dictionary.

calendar.description:
Its calendar, a global or resource calendar. Default is the default
global calendar.

max_units_per_hour.description:
Its limit: the most units per hour it can work, so 2 is two people
at once. Default is none.

resource.description: Its short name, the Resource ID.

units_per_hour.description:
Units per hour a new assignment starts with. Default is 1, a full
day's work each day for labor.

oneOf.description:
Set or clear a resource's limit, the most units per hour it can work.
Without `from`, every rate the resource has takes it, and a resource
with no rate gets one, with no prices, from the project's start. With `from`,
a rate starts that day with the prices in force then; a rate starting
that day already takes the limit instead. With no rate starting
before that day, a rate from the project's start keeps what held
before (TF-001).

from.description: The day the limit starts, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

max_units_per_hour.description: Units per hour, so 2 is two people at once; null clears it.

resource.description: The resource's short name or name.

oneOf.description:
Put a resource on an activity. Without units, it takes the resource's
default units per hour over the activity's durations.

resource.description: The resource's short name or name.

units.description:
Units, in hours for labor and nonlabor and the resource's unit for
material.

oneOf.description:
Set an assignment's actual or remaining units. Its remaining units per
hour and a cost linked to its units follow. On an activity measured by
units percent, the percent follows (docs/rules/TF-004-units-percent-complete.md).

actual_units.description:
Actual units, regular time: hours for labor and nonlabor, the
resource's unit for material.

resource.description: The resource's short name or name.

oneOf.description: Add a role to the file's role dictionary.

max_units_per_hour.description:
Its limit: the most units per hour of it the work can use, so 2
is two people at once. Default is none.

parent.description: The role it sits under, by short name or name. Default is none.

role.description: Its short name, the Role ID.

oneOf.description:
Set or clear a role's limit, the most units per hour of it the work
can use, as `set_resource_limit` does for a resource (TF-001).

from.description: The day the limit starts, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

max_units_per_hour.description: Units per hour, so 2 is two people at once; null clears it.

role.description: The role's short name or name.

oneOf.description:
Put a role on an activity with no resource yet, so the
work is staffed by kind before anyone is named.

role.description: The role's short name or name.

units.description: Units, in hours. Without them the assignment has none yet.

oneOf.description: Take a role with no resource off an activity.

role.description: The role's short name or name.

oneOf.description:
Add an expense to an activity: one unit at the budgeted cost, all of
it still to spend.

account.description: Its cost account, by short name or name. Default is none.

accrual.description: When its cost falls over the activity. Default is uniform.

category.description: Its expense category, by name. Default is none.

cost.description: Its budgeted cost, negative for a credit.

expense.description:
The expense item, unique on the activity, ignoring case and spaces
at the ends.

oneOf.description:
Change an expense's costs or accrual. Those left out stay as they are,
but a new budget on an expense with nothing spent moves its remaining
cost too.

accrual.description: When its cost falls over the activity.

oneOf.description: Remove an expense from an activity.

Book the costs of a resource's assignment, a role's assignment with
no resource, or an expense on an activity to a cost account, or to
none. Give one of `resource`, `role` or `expense`.

account.description:
The cost account, by its path (short names from the top of the
tree down, joined by dots, as `SITE.PERMIT`), or by short name or
name where one account has it. Without one, the costs are booked to
none.

resource.description: The resource whose assignment it is, by short name or name.

role.description: The role of an assignment with no resource, by short name or name.

oneOf.description: Take a resource off an activity.

resource.description: The resource's short name or name.

oneOf.description:
Spread a resource's units on an activity by a resource curve, or
evenly over its work without one. Clears any typed spread.

curve.description:
The curve's name, one of the file's. Without it, units spread
evenly.

resource.description: The resource's short name or name.

oneOf.description:
Type a resource's remaining units on an activity for each period, in
place of a curve. The periods follow one another from `start`, must
cover the remaining work between the activity's remaining dates, and
must add up to the remaining units.

resource.description: The resource's short name or name.

start.description:
The first period's first day, as `YYYY-MM-DD`; a month's is the
first of the month.

units.description: The units in each period, in order: hours for labor and nonlabor.

oneOf.description: Give an activity a code value, replacing any it holds of that type.
Take a code off an activity.
Add an activity code type.

max_length.description:
The longest value it holds, in characters. Default is 12, the
length most code types in real files have.

scope.description: Where it applies. Default is this project only.

oneOf.description: Add a value to a code type.

description.description: What it means. Default is the value.

oneOf.description:
Give an activity, WBS node, resource or assignment a user-defined
field value, checked against the field's data type. Name an activity,
a WBS node or a resource, or an activity and a resource for their
assignment.

activity.description: The Activity ID, for an activity's or assignment's value.

resource.description:
The resource's short name or name, for a resource's or
assignment's value.

value.description:
The value as text: `12.5`, `2026-03-02 08:00`, `UDF_G2` (or `2`)
for an indicator, or any text.

wbs.description: The WBS code or `wbs_id`, for a WBS node's value.

oneOf.description: Take a user-defined field value off a record, named as for `set_udf`.

resource.description: The resource's short name or name.

oneOf.description: Add a user-defined field. Fields belong to every project in the file.

Add a step to an activity. Where the project measures physical percent
by steps, the activity's physical percent follows (TF-042).

percent.description: Its percent complete, 0 to 100. Default is 0.

weight.description: Its weight against the activity's other steps. Default is 1.

oneOf.description:
Change a step's name, weight or percent complete; 100 marks it
complete, and less marks it not.
Mark a step complete: 100 percent.
Delete a step.

Add a note to an activity or a WBS node, under a notebook topic. The
text becomes simple HTML, a paragraph a line, as P6 stores notes.

activity.description: The Activity ID, for a note on an activity.

wbs.description: The WBS code or `wbs_id`, for a note on a WBS node.

oneOf.description: Replace an activity's or WBS node's note under a topic.

activity.description: The Activity ID, for a note on an activity.

wbs.description: The WBS code or `wbs_id`, for a note on a WBS node.

oneOf.description: Delete an activity's or WBS node's note under a topic.

activity.description: The Activity ID, for a note on an activity.

wbs.description: The WBS code or `wbs_id`, for a note on a WBS node.

oneOf.description:
Add a node to the OBS, the structure of who is responsible for work.
The OBS belongs to every project in the file.

description.description: What it is. Default is none.

parent.description: The node it sits under, by name or `obs_id`. Default is the top.

oneOf.description: Make an OBS node a WBS node's responsible manager.

Give the project a project code value, replacing any it holds of that
type.
Take a project code off the project.

Add a project code type. Project codes belong to every project in the
file.

max_length.description:
The longest value it holds, in characters. Default is 20, the
length most project code types in real files have.

oneOf.description: Add a value to a project code type.

description.description: What it means. Default is the value.

oneOf.description: Add a project calendar, copying another's working time.

copy_of.description: The calendar to copy. Default is the project's.

oneOf.description: Make a date a holiday, or give it its own shifts.

shifts.description: Shifts such as `08:00-12:00`. None makes the date a non-work day.

oneOf.description: Put a date back to the normal week.
Change one day of the work week.

shifts.description: Shifts such as `08:00-12:00`. None makes the day non-work.

oneOf.description:
Set how many hours a day is on a calendar, for spans given in days
(P6 `day_hr_cnt`). Changing the work week leaves this alone
(TF-033).

hours.description: Hours in a day, such as `8` or `7.5`, in whole minutes.

oneOf.description:
Set a calendar's hours in a week, month or year (P6 `week_hr_cnt`,
`month_hr_cnt` and `year_hr_cnt`): what a span in those units means
on it.

hours.description: Hours in it, such as `40` or `172`, in whole minutes.

oneOf.description: Add an activity. Work needs a duration, and a milestone has none.

calendar.description: Its calendar. Default is the project's.

wbs.description: Its WBS, by the code `query` shows.

oneOf.description: Delete an activity, with its links and assignments.
Add a relationship.

lag.description: Lag, such as `5d` or `-8h`. Default is none.

link_type.description: The relationship type. Default is finish to start.

oneOf.description:
Remove a relationship. `link_type` is needed only if two activities have
more than one.

link_type.description: Which relationship, if there are several.

oneOf.description:
Change a relationship's type or lag. `link_type` says which relationship
if two activities have more than one.

link_type.description: Which relationship, if there are several.

ExpenseAccrual.description: When an expense's cost falls over its activity.

oneOf.description: All at the activity's start. P6 `CL_Start`.
All at its finish. P6 `CL_End`.
Spread evenly over it. P6 `CL_Uniform`.

Kind.description: The activity types an edit can give, as `query` names them.

oneOf.description: Finish to start.
Start to start.
Finish to finish.
Start to finish.
An Activity ID; the source ID is `TASK.task_id`.
A WBS code; the source ID is `PROJWBS.wbs_id`.
A calendar name; the source ID is `CALENDAR.clndr_id`.
A resource short name or name; the source ID is `RSRC.rsrc_id`.
A role short name or name; the source ID is `ROLES.role_id`.

A month: `CALENDAR.month_hr_cnt`.
A year: `CALENDAR.year_hr_cnt`.

Resolved.description: A name an edit used, and what it meant when the edit was recorded.

id.description: Its source ID in that project's file.

name.description: The name as the edits give it, without any `PROJECT:` prefix.

project.description: The project it was found in (`proj_id`).

oneOf.description: People. P6 `RT_Labor`.
Equipment. P6 `RT_Equip`.
Material. P6 `RT_Mat`.
One project. P6 `AS_Project`.
Every project. P6 `AS_Global`.

Span.description: A span such as 15d, 120h, 2w, 1m or 1y. Days, weeks, months (m) and years use the calendar's hours in each.

SpreadPeriod.description: The periods typed units are given for.

oneOf.description: Calendar days.
Seven days, from the first period's first day.
Calendar months, from the first of a month.

UdfFor.description: What a user-defined field applies to.

WBS nodes (`PROJWBS`).
Resources (`RSRC`).
Resource assignments (`TASKRSRC`).

description:
One edit request: its edits and its own settings, so it can be saved,
reviewed and replayed.

resolved.description:
In history, what each name the edits used meant when they were
recorded, by source ID, so a replay on another branch finds a renamed
activity. `--edits` ignores it.
